name: System monitor
author: obouhlel
description: CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM usage in the bar, with a detail card on hover. Left click opens btop, right click drops RAM caches, middle click frees VRAM (NVIDIA).

barWidget.description: CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM at a glance.

schema.label: Show GPU and VRAM
schema.description: Turn off on a machine with no NVIDIA or AMD GPU, or to shorten the widget.

schema.label: Urgent threshold (%)
schema.description: From this value a reading turns the urgent colour; 25 points below it, a halfway colour.

schema.label: Refresh (seconds)
schema.description: CPU and RAM tick. GPU polls at half this rate — nvidia-smi is far heavier than a /proc read.
